description: Labour-resignation concierge + 使者 (messenger) — helps a worker resign with dignity (門出 = setting out on a new path), grounded in actual Japanese labour law, and RELAYS the worker's already-formed unilateral resignation (民法627 — a unilateral right; employer consent not required) as a 使者. It does NOT negotiate (弁護士法72条 非弁行為禁止); any matter needing negotiation (未払い賃金 / 退職条件 / 示談 / 損害賠償) is routed to a labour union (団体交渉) or a lawyer. Free, worker-authored, worker-submitted.
